key: Arise! Awake! Having reached the Great Ones (illumined Teachers), gain understanding.
s: After the parable of the chariot and the ascent beyond the senses, the section turns to exhortation; Śaṅkara, commentary on 1.3.14, hears scripture calling like a compassionate mother to beings asleep in beginningless ignorance to wake and realise the Self through a teacher.
src: Śaṅkara, Kaṭha Upaniṣad Bhāṣya 1.3.14, trans. S. Sitarama Sastri, The Katha and Prasna Upanishads and Sri Sankara’s Commentary, 2nd ed. (1928)

opened.edition: S. Sitarama Sastri, The Katha and Prasna Upanishads and Sri Sankara’s Commentary, 2nd ed. (1928)

evidence.words: arise, Oh, living beings sleeping in beginningless ignorance, i.e., turn towards the acquisition of the knowledge of the dtman ; and awake, i.e., put an end to the sleep of ignorance, horrible in form and the seed of all misery. How ? Having approached excellent preceptors who know that, realise the dtman taught by them, the innermost and in all, thus ' I am he/ This is not to be neglected. Thus, the sruti, like a mother, says from compassion
evidence.lang: en (Sitarama Sastri’s English translation of Śaṅkara’s Sanskrit)
evidence.gloss: Arise, living beings asleep in beginningless ignorance, turn to knowledge of the ātman; awake, end the sleep of ignorance, the seed of all misery; having approached excellent teachers who know it, realise the ātman they teach as I am he. So the śruti speaks, like a mother, out of compassion.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, ref Katha Upanishad 1.3.14, at [85]); three whole sentences, the translator’s parenthesis kept as printed and not used for the reading. Śaṅkara’s numbering places this verse at 1.3.14 as well. His commentary carries every element: beings asleep in beginningless ignorance, arise and awake, realise the ātman taught by excellent preceptors, the śruti speaking like a mother from compassion. Plain sense (after the chariot parable of 1.3.3 to 1.3.9 and the ascending series of 1.3.10 to 1.3.13, the section turns to exhortation) is faithful. entry-check ok.
